notes.title: Play God Machines at CD-Action Expo 2024 on June 1 & 2 2024!
notes.notes:
See you with #[b]RealGodsAreDigital[/b] on June 1go and 2go in [b]Lodz, Poland at CD-Action Expo 2024[/b]! Our [b]Fornix Games[/b] booth will give you the opportunity to play the latest build after many extensive changes and take part in the playtest of our [b]God Machines[/b] game https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177890/God_Machines/

Drop by our booth alone or with your friends to start the real battle. Join the playtest live! Expect an amazing strategic duel as God Machine. 

• Completely revamped UI in Assembler in particular - easier and more interesting team creation
• New Art in Human Combatants
• Redesigned and more balanced Battle UI - now much easier and find yourself in battle, everything is much more dynamic and fluid 
• Refinement of many animations during combat
• Implemented valuable feedback from our faithful GM community of players and volunteer testers - many thanks again to everyone!


Welcome to a machine-dominated world, where ruthless God Machines reign. Are you ready to leave your human sentiments behind? Brace yourself for a blood-soaked journey through a post-apocalyptic wasteland, where the shattered corpses of your enemies pave the path of your adventure. Can you beat the AI in the challenges or other players in multiplayer? If you never try, you’ll never know! We hope you are just as hungry for power as God Machines are. Step into the shoes of a newborn god to claim unrivaled supremacy and determine the future of the primitive lifeforms that swarm this planet. Prove your worth. Glory to the Machines!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43422505/f58b44cdd1410002c6c76bf2205b219c00dd2496.png[/img]

[b]God Machines[/b] is a turn-based tactical RPG with rogue-like features set in a dystopian post-nuclear universe. Play as a sentient AI, a so-called God Machine, whose goal is to conquer the remnants of a devastated world. Assemble a squad of battle-effective Combatants, investigate this hostile world to gather resources, and annihilate everything that stands in your way.You are what brings terror. You are not just Machine. You are a God.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43422505/f1df38f2fa645d6b985063aad83583ae26bedaa3.png[/img]

notes.title: Play God Machines during Road to Hell Games 7!
notes.notes:
Join our [b]Fornixa Games[/b] gaming attractions and speech during [b]Road to Hell Games 7 (RTHG)[/b] 🔥 on March 9, 2024. We will reveal the newest version of [b]God Machines[/b] as well as explore the community-driven and aesthetic approach in game design, development and marketing. Event is organized by Liga Fantasium.

Check YouTube video: [previewyoutube=RBClKp539jk;full][/previewyoutube]

Check our short: [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/jXae-Nf8qyM]https://youtube.com/shorts/jXae-Nf8qyM[/url]

As speakers 🎤 Bartosz Borusiewicz (Co-Founder and Executive Director at Fornixa Games) and 🎤 Paweł Sobotkowski (Co-Founder and Marketing Director at Fornixa Games) will be giving a speech on "[i][b]The importance of community-driven and aesthetic approach in game design, development and marketing[/b][/i]"

• Importance of the quality and aesthetics aspects in the game development — how to stay unique and attract gamers
• Real cases of community-driven development
• How important is community in games and how increase of games number affects gamers behaviours and video games market?
• The key marketing practices and activities to implement when creating video game


Real gods are digital! Join our stand during RTHG event and play God Machines with us! Take your friends and play together against each other.
